mapper.select: select a.*, u.real_name as user_name from oa_attendance a left join sys_user u on a.user_id = u.id order by a.id desc
select a.*, u.real_name as user_name from oa_attendance a left join sys_user u on a.user_id = u.id where a.user_id = #{userId} order by a.id desc
select a.*, u.real_name as user_name from oa_attendance a left join sys_user u on a.user_id = u.id where a.user_id = #{userId} and date(a.attendance_date) = curdate() order by a.id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into oa_attendance(user_id, attendance_date, check_in_time, check_out_time, check_in_status, check_out_status, day_status, exception_remark) values(#{userId}, #{attendanceDate}, #{checkInTime}, #{checkOutTime}, #{checkInStatus}, #{checkOutStatus}, #{dayStatus}, #{exceptionRemark})
mapper.update: update oa_attendance set check_in_time = #{checkInTime}, check_out_time = #{checkOutTime}, check_in_status = #{checkInStatus}, check_out_status = #{checkOutStatus}, day_status = #{dayStatus}, exception_remark = #{exceptionRemark} where id = #{id}
